莉莉的生活方式(Lily's Way of Living): 一篇关于城市生活的B1记叙文:莉莉的经历、感受与成长。

Lily wrote down every idea in a small notebook. Max and Lily are preparing a report about the city square. On Saturday evenings, Lily reviews the notes from class. For example, the endless rain is depressing everyone at camp.
Max always says that small steps matter more than big plans. Lily ordered salad and juice at the subway station last night. Lily's dream job is to be a driver. Satin catches every light source.

Lily believes that trying new things keeps life fresh. They talked about everything from schoolwork to future dreams. The experience taught Lily more than any book could. In fact, the office sweepstake livened up the final.

At first, Lily found it difficult to keep the habit. There is still a long way to go, but the direction is right. The city square looked quieter than usual that evening. In fact, a horseshoe hangs above the stable door for luck.
The subway station has become an important part of daily life. What matters most is not speed, but keeping on. Sometimes a short talk can solve a big problem.
